title: Recording with Almerico, not Hirt
summary: Netto made no records with Hirt but recorded with Tony Almerico during the war; the records were reportedly taken and issued by Mares.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Did you do any recording with Jumbo?
No, I didn't make any records with Jumbo. I recorded with Amarillo.

How long did you play with Tony? Oh, I played with Tony... During the war, I was with him. I played on a Capitol Ave with him. You made the records then? We made a few records, but I never heard of them coming out anywhere.

See if they... Oh, I wouldn't look them up because this guy, Mares... Well, you know, he and Pete... Pete and Al hate each other. There's no question about it, but they get together every now and then and make a buck. But then... And Mares stole the records from them and turned them out. And I don't know the whole story of it. But he's been known for Duda, that Mares guy. Now his brother, the trumpet... Paul. Yeah, Paul. I don't know too much of him either.
